findings.summary: Rust preflight does not reject non-executable generation artifacts before service mutation.
Authoritative SOR does not retain exact-final-SHA validation truth.
Generation corruption can prevent the governed stop path from stopping a running service.

residual_risks: Review ran on macOS; Linux systemd behavior was inspected but not executed.
No live Runtime or service-manager mutation was performed.
